core._help: rule: key names (README before JOB, both at the root) and then the most linked (purchasing/notes.md, 2 inbound). with_pin: --core data/profile.yaml goes first and the rule fills the rest.

accumulated._help: without --mark-read in between, the second change adds to the first; threshold 0.30 so that 2 changes stay reread with or without the sheet

replaced._help: The replaced list is the most linked file, so without the rule it would enter the core. «en» uses «**Replaces:** `file`»; «es» uses the Spanish table field «| **Reemplaza a** | name |» with a bare name.
